newsitem.title: USA: Boston Edison reduces Mass. nuke output.
newsitem.headline: Boston Edison reduces Mass. nuke output.

text.p: Boston Edison Co has reduced power output at its 670 megawatt Pilgrim nuclear power plant at Plymouth, Massachusetts for a test, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The unit was operating at 65 percent of capacity early Monday, and had reduced electrical output for a "power suppression test," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Boston Edison officials were not immediately available to comment on the power reduction or when the unit would return to full operations.
